name: B10-0417/2026 (S&D, Verts/ALE) – Post-electoral repression in Zambia and the killing of Mutotwe Kafwaya
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-electoral repression in Zambia and the killing of Mutotwe Kafwaya
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on events in Zambia after the August 2026 elections. It condemns the crackdown on opposition members and supporters, the shooting of Mutotwe Kafwaya, and the closing of courts. It asks Zambia to stop arbitrary arrests, free detainees or charge them, investigate the killing, and protect journalists and free speech. It also asks the European Union to raise these concerns with Zambia and to support civil society and journalists.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and a set of requests, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Zambia's government, police and courts; opposition members, detainees, journalists and civil society in Zambia.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the EU Council and Commission, the African Union, the United Nations and Zambia's government and parliament.
